app.title: SevaMitra
app.subtitle: AI-Powered Government Service Assistant for Rural Citizens
app.tagline: Ask in your language, hear the answer, understand your rights.

lang_modal.title: Choose Your Language / மொழியைத் தேர்ந்தெடுக்கவும்
lang_modal.subtitle: Select your preferred language. You can speak or type and receive voice answers.
lang_modal.english_desc: Get all schemes, voice answers, and checklists in English
lang_modal.tamil_desc: அனைத்து அரசுத் திட்டங்கள் மற்றும் குரல் வழிகாட்டலை தமிழில் பெறவும்

hero.badge: Official Verified Schemes • Free Citizen Helpdesk
hero.heading: Know Your Government Schemes Without Confusion
hero.description: Speak or type in your language. Discover subsidies, pensions, welfare schemes, verify your documents, and follow step-by-step guides.
hero.type_placeholder: Ask e.g., 'Am I eligible for old age pension?' or 'How to apply for PM-Kisan?'

voice_recovery.listening: Listening... Please speak your question now.
voice_recovery.no_speech: We didn't hear anything. Please try speaking again or click an option below.
voice_recovery.unclear: Could not recognize the speech clearly. Would you like to try again or pick a service?
voice_recovery.or_choose: Or choose what you want to do:

modules.assistant_desc: Ask any question by voice or text. Answers are grounded in verified government documents.
modules.recommend_desc: Enter basic details (age, occupation, income) to instantly see schemes you may qualify for.
modules.doc_checker_desc: Scan or upload your papers to check if required details (Aadhaar, income) are ready.
modules.tracking_desc: Step-by-step checklist of application stages with reminders and progress saving.

doc_checker.title: Verify Your Papers Before Visiting e-Seva Centre
doc_checker.description: Upload Aadhaar, Income Certificate, or Land Records to verify prerequisites and avoid multiple office visits.
doc_checker.upload_label: 2. Or Upload Your Document Photo or PDF:
doc_checker.upload_drop_text: Click or tap to upload document photo
doc_checker.upload_formats: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, or Patta (PNG, JPG, PDF)
doc_checker.privacy_note: Privacy Notice: Documents are processed strictly in-memory and discarded immediately without disk storage.
doc_checker.tip_light: Capture photo in bright daylight; avoid harsh flash reflections
doc_checker.tip_seal: Ensure official Tahsildar / VAO stamps and signatures are visible
doc_checker.tip_flat: Keep document flat without folded corners or unreadable angles
doc_checker.next_step_ready: Your papers appear ready! Take original physical copies to your nearest Taluk office or e-Seva centre.
doc_checker.next_step_action: Re-take photo in brighter light or visit VAO office to obtain clear income certificate seal.

guide.title: Clear Guidance from Application to Bank Credit
guide.description: Follow ordered steps, save your collected documents, and track your application progress.
guide.checklist_note: Your selections are saved automatically on this device so you can return anytime.

disclaimers.official_note: Information is sourced from official government portals. This tool provides preliminary guidance and is not an official government approval body.
